info.title: gifcompressors API
info.summary: Programmatic GIF compression from the gifcompressors.com team.
info.description: Compress animated GIFs over a single REST endpoint. Files are processed in memory and never stored or logged. Rate limit: 12 requests per minute per IP, free, no API key. Human alternative with live preview: https://www.gifcompressors.com/compress-gif/

post.description: Returns the compressed GIF bytes directly (image/gif). Reduction is driven by palette quantization plus frame differencing: measured 96% on the public demo file, 99% when combined with max_width=240. Response headers X-Original-Bytes, X-Compressed-Bytes, X-Reduction-Percent, X-Gif-Frames, X-Gif-Colors report the run; X-Target-Met tells whether target_kb was reached.

file.description: Animated or static GIF, up to 25 MB

target_kb.description: Iterate settings until the output fits this size; nearest result is returned if unreachable

max_width.description: Optionally resize to this width (height keeps aspect) before compressing

image/gif.description: Or send the GIF as the raw body and pass mode/target_kb/max_width as query parameters.

422.description: Unreadable GIF or animation beyond the processing budget (60M pixel-frames).

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (12 req/min/IP). Browser tools have no limits.
